Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: GERMAN BRAILLE
Topic 9.2: UN- CONTRACTED BRAILLE
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers UN- CONTRACTED BRAILLE, part of GERMAN BRAILLE in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: How do you indicate a letter sign in German braille?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
